# Layer ids as names QGIS fixture

A hand-written project with **Use layer ids as names** ticked under WMS capabilities in the QGIS Server tab of Project Properties. It was not saved by QGIS Desktop.

On the server route each Collection's id is then the QGIS layer id, which is also the project file's id, so both catalogues use the same ids. The WFS type name stays the layer's name, as QGIS Server publishes it.
